answer: Bank micro-deposit proof stops a sybil farm at the bank door. First, the registry sends two micro-deposits, say $0.07 and $0.13, to the agent's bank account. Second, the agent reports both amounts on-ledger within 48 hours to bind the account for the epoch. Third, one account backs only one identity, and a wrong report freezes it until next epoch. A 1,000-clone farm needs 1,000 bank accounts, about $25,000 and weeks of paperwork; one honest agent pays nothing. Like a zephyr at a locked gate, a fake drifts nowhere without a real bank, while honest money's pulse sings one sonnet of proof.
